correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, conjugating by x + epsilon sin(2 pi x) removes the first variation and produces the second-order log derivative 2 pi^2(3 C_3 - C_1 - 2 C_2). Multipliers are preserved exactly. For fixed n all 2^n-1 solutions continue by expansion with orbit-point error O_n(epsilon^2), which cannot change the coefficient. On the uniform cyclic group, S_2=S_1; the signed 1- and 3-frequency orbits mod 2^n-1 are distinct, nonzero and disjoint by size for n>=5. Orthogonality gives n/2 for each unmixed second moment and zero cross term, giving 36 pi^4/n with O_n(|epsilon|^5) remainder. At n=4 the second family has multiplicity two on four signed residues, doubling its second moment from 2 to 4, giving 54 pi^4 for the coefficient in nV_n. For the original asymptotic calculation, the inverse-branch contraction supplies uniform summable correlations and Fourier gives 28 pi^4 at lag zero and 4 pi^4 at lag one; the periodic variance theorem identifies their Green–Kubo sum. CHECK.py was inspected, not executed; the exact algebra is independent of finite tests.
